$comment: AraminConsole module manifest. Paths are relative to src/. 'core' is always included. Folders in src/modules/<name>/ are discovered automatically (module.json inside the folder may add description / dependencies); run `node scripts/build.mjs --sync-manifest` to write them and the measured sizes back here. See docs/modules.md.

modules.name: core
modules.description: Tokens, base, app-shell layout, motion system, atoms (button, card, misc), base form controls and tables (static markup is always styled) and the runtime: AC namespace, auto-init registry, i18n, theme, format, gestures, focus trap, AC.use() lazy loader.

modules.name: shell
modules.description: App chrome behaviour: rail / dock / flyout, bottom tab bar, large title, tabs & segmented, command palette, press ripple, pull-to-refresh, progress ring.

modules.name: overlays
modules.description: Layer stack + positioning, modal, bottom sheet, drawer, menus / action sheets, popover, tooltip, confirm & prompt, toast, alert, notification center.

modules.name: customizer
modules.description: Theme customizer drawer (theme, accent, density, radius, language, digits). Styles ship with overlays.

modules.name: langpicker
modules.description: Data-driven language picker: popover on desktop, bottom sheet on phones, crossfades into the new direction.

modules.name: forms
modules.description: Inputs, floating labels, password, OTP, number, range, rating, tags, swatches, combobox / multi-select, file dropzone, inline validation, wizard. Styles ship with core.

modules.name: datepicker
modules.description: Jalali + Gregorian date / range / time pickers and AC.date helpers.

modules.name: data-display
modules.description: Swipeable lists, accordion, tree view, code block / JSON viewer, log viewer, description lists, timeline.

modules.name: table
modules.description: Data table: sort, search, filters, pagination, selection + bulk bar, column visibility, expansion, CSV, card list on phones. Styles ship with core.

modules.name: chart
modules.description: Inline-SVG charts: line, area, bar, donut, gauge, sparkline, heatmap.

modules.name: apps
modules.description: App-screen styles (mail, chat, calendar, files, kanban) + kanban drag & drop and split panes.

modules.name: money
modules.description: Money input & formatting, Iranian banks (logos, IBAN / Sheba, card numbers), bank card form.

modules.name: chat
modules.description: Messenger panel: conversation list (filters, pinned, unread, muted), direct / group / channel threads, reactions, reply/quote, edit, delete, forward, voice notes, image lightbox, link previews, read receipts, typing, infinite scroll up, info sidebar with media / files / links, new chat modal; phones: push/pop stack.

modules.name: files
modules.description: Finder / Explorer-class file, document and records manager on a pluggable storage adapter: icons / list / columns / gallery views, real content thumbnails (images, video frames, text/CSV/Markdown pages, audio waveforms, server renditions; pdf.js optional plugin), preview pane, Quick Look, Get Info inspector with document records (type, number, parties, expiry reminders, approval, OCR), versions, sharing, tags, drag & drop, marquee, clipboard, uploads with pause/resume and conflict resolution, trash; phones: Files-app layout.

modules.name: mail
modules.description: Email client: folders + coloured labels, threads, bulk actions, search filters, snooze, swipe actions, floating / minimisable compose with rich text, chips + autocomplete, attachments, signature, schedule send, draft autosave, undo send, settings.

modules.name: notify
modules.description: AC.notify(): toast, rich card, banner, inline, undo snackbar, progress, dynamic island, system & Web Push — routed by per-user preferences (settings card), with sound, haptics, grouping and priority.

modules.name: prose
modules.description: Long-form reading: .ac-prose typography (fa/ar/en, mixed direction), zero-dependency XSS-safe Markdown renderer (AC.markdown), article chrome (reading progress, sticky TOC with scroll-spy, reading time, lightbox), blog cards, docs layout and Markdown editor styles.

modules.name: pwa
modules.description: Service-worker lifecycle with update toast, install invitation (sheet / banner / card / inline / iOS steps), app badge, Web Share, standalone tweaks, splash, network status, background-sync outbox.

modules.name: support-chat
modules.description: Floating support chat widget: launcher with unread badge, Intercom-style panel (home, conversation with typing / quick replies / attachments / emoji / read receipts, help articles, offline form); phones: full-screen sheet.

modules.name: tickets
modules.description: Help desk: ticket inbox (queue views, filters, priority / status / live SLA chips, bulk assign), ticket detail (thread, internal notes, attachments, canned replies, macros, merge, SLA timer, properties, tags, CSAT, activity), create-ticket modal, customer status timeline; phones: list → detail push.

modules.name: user-panel
modules.description: Customer 'my account' home blocks: wallet card with privacy toggle, profile completeness ring, quick-action app grid, order step tracker, notification / ticket rows, security checklist, time-aware greeting.
